get.description:
The text extracted from the resource's content, with where each run of it is on a page: the Archivist's answer, passed through as it arrives. It is always one of the members of `AnchoredTextAnswer`, and `kind` says which: the text (`extracted`), a stored decline (`declined`), or why there is none (`not-yet`, `no-map`, `unknown`). An absence is an answer and not an error: `not-yet` says to ask again, and the other two do not.

This is a read of content, so it is here and not on the bus: an anchored text is as large as its document, and bytes do not ride the bus.

200.description: The anchored text, a stored decline, or why there is none.

Cache-Control.description: An answer of `not-yet` becomes the text once the Smelter has read the content, so a cache must revalidate.

404.description: The path's `{id}` is not a `ResourceId` and so names no resource. A resource the knowledge base does not hold is not a 404 here: it is answered `unknown`.
